about: What the dossier is about, whatever the domain. A dossier has one to three. Keep this list short: a topic should fit many dossiers.

values.label: AI agents
values.means: How AI agents work and how to run them: tools, permissions, memory, sandboxes, multi-agent setups.

values.label: AI models
values.means: Choosing and using models: quality, cost, speed, effort settings, context limits and provider terms.

values.label: Prompts and skills
values.means: Writing for models: prompts, instruction files, skills and how well each one is followed.

values.label: Workflow
values.means: How work moves from idea to done: planning, slicing, issues, review, merging and release.

values.label: Research methods
values.means: How to find, check and record evidence: sources, fact-checks, provenance and statistics.

values.label: Knowledge keeping
values.means: Organising what is known: tags, indexes, IDs, versions, docs and keeping them fresh.

values.label: Performance
values.means: Making things fast and small: load time, latency, memory, bundle size and how to measure them.

values.label: Security
values.means: Stopping attacks and abuse: access control, secrets, injection, bots, rate limits and incident lessons.

values.label: Privacy
values.means: Keeping personal data private: what is collected, who can see it, and how to get it removed.

values.label: Accessibility
values.means: Making things usable by everyone: screen readers, keyboards, contrast, motion and WCAG.

values.label: Testing
values.means: Proving that something works: unit and end-to-end tests, evals, flaky tests and test data.

values.label: CI and delivery
values.means: Automatic checks and shipping: pipelines, previews, deploys, rollbacks and their cost.

values.label: Architecture
values.means: How a system is put together: layers, modules, APIs, boundaries and the trade-offs between designs.

values.label: Databases
values.means: Storing and querying app data: schemas, migrations, SQL engines, sync and backups.

values.label: File storage
values.means: Where big files live: object stores, Git LFS, datasets, quotas, checksums and links that last.

values.label: Hosting
values.means: Where things run: serverless platforms, small servers, containers, DNS and their limits and prices.

values.label: Design
values.means: How things look and feel: layout, colour, type, motion, design systems and critique.

values.label: Graphics and 3D
values.means: Drawing on screen: SVG, canvas, WebGL, 3D scenes, shaders and frame rate.

values.label: Voice
values.means: Speaking and listening: speech to text, text to speech, wake words and spoken assistants.

values.label: Search and sharing
values.means: Being found and shared: search engines, AI crawlers, metadata and link previews.

values.label: Licensing
values.means: Licences for code, text and data: what they allow, how they mix and how to choose one.

values.label: Open source
values.means: Running or using open projects: contributions, governance, maintenance and dependencies.

values.label: Hardware and devices
values.means: Physical things: phones, laptops, home devices, printers, sensors and how they behave.

values.label: Pricing and plans
values.means: What things cost: plans, quotas, free tiers and how the bill grows.
